passages.title: AMOREPACIFIC 2024 Entry-Level Recruitment_Foreign Applicants (~9/23
passages.text:
[AMOREPACIFIC] 2024 Entry-Level Recruitment_Foreign Applicants (~9/23)
■ Application period : ~ September 23(Mon) 2024, 11:59 PM(KST)
■ Apply
- Online application through Amorepacific recruitment website( https://m.site.naver. com/1sKqu )
- Sign Up → JOB APPLY → Open Jobs → Select position and Apply → Update My Profile
- If you already registered your application in the other existing talent pool, click modify and then apply.
■ Recruiting section : Global Sales, Global Marketing
■ Qualifications
- Graduates with a Bachelor’s degree or higher, or scheduled to graduate by February 2025
※ Applicants with no restrictions on 6 months full-time internship during January ~ June, 2025
※ D-2/D-10/E-7/F-2/F-4/F-5/F-6 visa holders can also apply
※ Internship is conducted under D-10 visa, and E-7 visia will be supported when transition to a permanent employee.
- Applicants who have no reason for disqualification for overseas travel or health
(in case of a man, who has completed or exempted from military service)
- GPA : No credit restrictions
- TOPIK(Korean Language Proficiency Test) Level 4 submission
Korean language grades must be submitted.
Other language grades submission is not necessary.
- Other second language grades are also given preferential treatment
■ Recruitment process
Document Screening > 1st Interview > Full-time Internship(6 months) >
Culture-Fit Interview / 2nd Interview > Final announcement

Q20 How many majors and universities can I apply for admission?
A20
If you apply through the university track, you may choose only ONE university
and ONE major offered for GKS.
If you apply through the embassy track, you may choose THREE universities
under Type A and B. Please remember that at least one of your three choices has to
be chosen from Type B universities.
Note that you may choose the same major for all three universities. However, you
may NOT choose three different majors from a single university. Please refer to
the application guidelines.
8
Q21 I am planning to apply via university track. May I apply for a major in the field of liberal arts and social science at one of the regional universities?
A21
Yes, you may as long as the university of your choice offers a degree program and
majors for GKS scholars. Please refer to the available fields of study listed in the
“2021 GKS-G University Information” file posted with the 2021 GKS-G
Application Guidelines on our website, www.studyinkorea.go.kr.

universities, while choosing a major in the field of liberal arts and social science.

quota is reserved for natural science and engineering majors applying to regional
universities. Please refer to the application guidelines for more information.

Q22
I am going to apply for the program via embassy track. According to the
application guidelines, applicants should choose up to 3 preferred universities and
departments (or majors). Are there tips on choosing those universities and majors?
A22
Embassy track applicants should understand that passing the second round of
selection will not guarantee an admission to the university that you have chosen.
There are cases with Embassy track applicants who fail to be selected from all
three universities if they choose among highly competitive universities.
Each Korean university has recognition for variety of fields and has its own
strength. Please conduct your own research to find out which university is the
leading institution in the field of study you would like to pursue.
Q23
I am an embassy track applicant. I am aware that I have to choose at least one
university from Type B universities. Does this mean that I can only choose one
university from Type B?
A23
No. You can choose at least one university from Type B. In other words, your all
three choices may not be chosen just from Type A. However, should you wish,
your all three choices can be chosen from Type B.

I am going to apply for the program via embassy track. According to the

Embassy track applicants should understand that passing the second round of

There are cases with Embassy track applicants who fail to be selected from all

Each Korean university has recognition for variety of fields and has its own
strength. Please conduct your own research to find out which university is the
leading institution in the field of study you would like to pursue.

Q. Should I include a detailed research proposal in the Study Plan?
A. Yes. You must at least describe the general direction and outlines of your study plans, if not in
full detail. Please elaborate on your study objectives in Korea, tangible plans during and after
you complete the degree program.
Q. I am planning to apply through a university track. Can I submit my application to
multiple universities?
A. University track applicants can only apply to one university and one department. If an
applicant is found to have applied to more than two universities, his/her application document
will be excluded from the next round of evaluation. Even after the announcement of qualified
applicants, scholarships may be cancelled.
Embassy track applicants whose application have not passed the first round may apply to a
university track once more. However, applicants cannot apply for both tracks at once.
Q. My name on my birth certificate is different from the one on my graduation certificate.
What should I do when the names are different on the documents?
A. Applicant must apply with the name on their passport. If the name on your passport is
different from other documents, please provide a supplementary document issued by your
government that explains the discrepancy.
Q. How will I know if I have passed each assessment?
A. Result of the first round of selection will be announced by each embassy and university.

Q. I am a citizen of China/Czech Republic. In the application guidelines, there is quota only
assigned in the embassy track for the Chinese/Czech citizens. Does that mean that I must
apply to the Korean Embassy in my country?
A. If you are a Chinese citizen, you should submit your applications to China Scholarship Council
(CSC) under the Ministry of Education in China instead of the Korean Embassy in China. This is
based on the mutual agreement between Korean and China. Likewise, a Czech citizen must also
submit the application to the Ministry of Education in Czech Republic, in accordance with the
mutual agreement between the governments of Korea and Czech Republic.

nearby Korean consulate. Korean embassy in Washington and Korean consulate in L.A. will
cooperate to conduct the first round of selection. Please contact the

A. Yes. You must at least describe the general direction and outlines of your study plans, if not in

Q. I am planning to apply through a university track. Can I submit my application to
multiple universities?
A. University track applicants can only apply to one university and one department. If an
applicant is found to have applied to more than two universities, his/her application document
will be excluded from the next round of evaluation. Even after the announcement of qualified
applicants, scholarships may be cancelled.
Embassy track applicants whose application have not passed the first round may apply to a
university track once more. However, applicants cannot apply for both tracks at once.

What should I do when the names are different on the documents?
A. Applicant must apply with the name on their passport. If the name on your passport is
different from other documents, please provide a supplementary document issued by your
government that explains the discrepancy.

Eligibility: Applicants for Master's or Doctoral Programs Abroad Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree from Hanyang University and have a GPA of 3.5 or higher in both undergraduate and master's programs (master's degrees may be conferred from Hanyang University or other universities)
Applicants must apply within 3 years of obtaining their bachelor's or master's degree (excluding the military service period)
Applicants must be scheduled to enroll in an overseas master's/doctorate program sometime during the year of their application
Applicants must be under 35 years of age
Applicants must not otherwise be disqualified from studying abroad
Applicants must speak the language of the hosting country or be able to attend classes delivered in English (if classes are delivered in English regardless of the native language of the hosting country) ※ Foreign language proficiency scores must be from the past 2 years to qualify. ※ For English-speaking countries, the minimum scores are 91 for TOEFL IBT, or 6.5 for IELTS (same applies to applicants majoring in arts and physical education). ※ GRE, TOEIC, etc. scores are not recognized as language proficiency scores, but may be used for reference during the application process. ※ For other language-speaking countries, students must submit their language proficiency scores administered by the hosting country government (additional English scores may be required). ※ If the hosting country does not have a state-administered language proficiency test, students must submit their English proficiency scores.
If students receive multiple scholarships from other institutions, they must indicate whether they have received such scholarships.

Q. The degree program I applied to is taught in English only. May I be exempt from the
Korean Language Program?
A. A yearlong Korean language program is an important part of the GKS program. All GKS
scholars must take a Korean language program regardless of the curriculum of the degree
program.
However, if you have already attained advanced level (Level 5 or 6) on TOPIK when applying
for the program, you must submit your valid TOPIK certificate to be exempt from Korean
language program. You will directly start your degree program from September 2023.
Applicants who attained TOPIK level 5 or 6 after the initial application deadline must submit the
valid TOPIK certificate to NIIED by June 14, 2023. (*Acceptable TOPIK certificates: The 74st ~
86th score)
If you attain TOPIK level 5 or 6 during the first 6 months of Korean language program, you will
be exempt from the remaining 6-month language program, and you must start your degree
program in the following semester (March, 2024).
Q. May I change my final university choice during my Korean language program or during
a degree program?
A. No, you cannot. Changing the university or transferring to another university is NOT
PERMITTED under any circumstances.

a degree program?

passages.section: What is a Subsidized Study Abroad Program?
passages.text: In 1981, Hanyang University became the first university in Korea to offer a subsidized study aboard program. The program provides scholarships to Hanyang University graduates who wish to study abroad for their master's or doctoral programs. It produces a large number of talented professionals each year and plays a key role in various aspects of society. The university is always on the lookout for interested graduates. Specific application windows and detailed selection requirements may be slightly modified each year, so please be sure to check the recruitment notice before applying (read online notices).

only accepts applications from embassies or universities through official documents and
does not accept applications from individual applicants. Any documents mistakenly sent
to NIIED will be excluded from the screening and will not be returned.
Q. When is the deadline for the application?

each institution to find out the application deadline. Embassies and universities that

please check with the embassy/university regarding any submission related inquiries
such as application deadline, submission method, etc.

Q. I am curious about the validity of the authenticated documents. Can I submit my
graduation certificate that was apostilled last year?
A. If there is an expiration date on an apostilled or consular confirmed document, the
validity of the document will be judged based on the date indicated on the authentication.
If there is no specific date indicated, the document will be accepted if it was submitted
within 2 years from the date of authentication.
Q. I have graduated from another country. Therefore, I cannot obtain an apostille
on my certificates from my government or apply for a consular confirmation from
the Korean embassy in my country. How should I submit my graduation certificate
and academic transcript that were issued from another country?
A. If your documents were issued from the university or from a government abroad, you
should obtain an apostille if the relevant country is a member of the Apostille
Convention. If you are not able to obtain an apostille from abroad, please check if you
can obtain a consular confirmation from the embassy/consulate of the relevant country.

passages.section: Job Announcement: Invitation for Instructors to Teach Mathematics in English
passages.text:
The Hanyang University Institute of International Education is seeking instructors to teach foundation-level Mathematics in English for government-sponsored students from the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
1. Student Information
Number of students: 6
All students are UAE nationals who have graduated from high school with excellent academic records as government scholarship recipients.
They are currently enrolled in the Korean Language Program at the Hanyang University Institute of International Education.
2. Course Content
Mathematics: Foundational topics preparing students for Engineering Mathematics and Calculus at the freshman level of the College of Engineering.
3. Teaching Period and Schedule
Periods: September 8, 2025 (Mon) – November 21, 2025 (Fri) (excluding the Chuseok holiday)
Schedule: 3 days per week, 14:00 – 17:00 (3 hours × 3 times per week × 10 weeks = total 90 hours)
4. Venue
Lecture room, International Building (Graduate School / Civil Engineering Building), Hanyang University Seoul Campus
5. Compensation
KRW 120,000 per hour
This program corresponds to the Fall 2025 semester. It will also be offered in the Winter semester (Dec 2025 – Feb 2026) and Spring semester (Mar – May 2026), each lasting 10 weeks. Based on the results of the Fall semester teaching evaluation, instructors may be invited to continue in the Winter and Spring semesters.
6. Qualifications
Applicants must be majoring in a science or engineering field (Master‘s degree or higher), and able to teach Mathematics in English.
7. Application and Contact Information

Cultivating electrical energy expertise to address future
energy challenges
Electrical energy represents the foundational energy source across engineering disciplines, enabling
functionality from residential applications to robotic systems and precision control mechanisms. The
field demonstrates increasing significance amid the contemporary focus on renewable and alternative
energy development. Electrical engineering encompasses the comprehensive study of electrical
systems from generation and transmission through consumption processes. The Electrical Engineering
program at Hanyang University's School of Electrical and Biomedical Engineering encompasses three
primary concentrations: future electric energy systems, plasma and electrical materials, and artificial
intelligence integration with control and signal processing. The future electrical energy concentration
examines next-generation electrical energy generation, control systems, transmission methods, and
conversion processes. The concentration of plasma and electrical materials addresses plasma electricity
applications, process equipment development, electrical semiconductor material processes, and wireless
power transmission technologies. The artificial intelligence, control, and signal processing concentration
advances methodologies for optimizing electrical generation, conversion, and utilization efficiency.
The program provides comprehensive education across electrical engineering domains, including
generation systems, conversion processes, transmission technologies, consumption patterns, and control
mechanisms, addressing future energy challenges through integrated electrical solutions.

Nutrition
The course examines physiological and biochemical nutrient functions essential for human life maintenance and analyzes optimal nutrient
requirements for health maintenance. Students develop an understanding of the fundamental properties, functions, metabolism, and sources
of five primary nutrients.
Food Analytics The course presents comprehensive food component analysis methodologies, examining sampling techniques and analytical methods for moisture, fats, proteins, carbohydrates, fiber, metals, vitamins, and specialized ingredients.
Clinical Nutrition The course analyzes nutrition-related disease diagnosis, treatment, and prevention strategies based on nutrient-body interactions, examining deficiency conditions, excess consumption, and metabolic imbalances.
Food Processing and
Storage
The course examines physical, chemical, and biological transformations during food processing and storage, analyzing manufacturing
process characteristics and storage methodology principles across food categories. Based on the theory and knowledge of food processing
and storage, students understand each food item's chemical and physical characteristics and learn related preventive and operational
methods.
Food Hygiene The course presents contemporary food hygiene trends, including food poisoning analysis, spoilage prevention, hygiene measures, contamination sources, food additives, and carcinogen relationships, developing preventive expertise for food safety.

The Department of Media Communication (formerly the Department of Journalism & Mass
Communication) examines diverse media and communication phenomena in contemporary society.
Media communication studies represent an interdisciplinary convergence point, integrating multiple
social sciences, including sociology, psychology, economics, political science, and information science.
Communication, encompassing expressing and transmitting thoughts and feelings through verbal,
written, and symbolic means, is a fundamental component of societal function. As noted by Peter
Drucker, “self-expression represents a critical human capability, with modern business and management
fundamentally dependent on communication competency.” Communication proficiency proves essential
across professional effectiveness, interpersonal relationships, persuasive discourse, and personal
development. Media serves as the primary vehicle for this communication process. The contemporary
media landscape demonstrates rapid evolution, advancing beyond traditional channels such as
correspondence, print journalism, radio, and television. Digital platforms, including internet applications,
interactive gaming, and social media networks accessed through computers and mobile devices, reflect
increasing technological sophistication in modern communication systems.
Contemporary society demonstrates extensive integration with media systems. Individual citizens,
commercial enterprises, and governmental institutions utilize diverse media platforms and artificial
intelligence tools, creating widespread societal impact. The Department of Media Communication
develops professionals with advanced communication capabilities and media literacy skills aligned with
contemporary societal requirements.

curriculum examines reinforced concrete's material properties and design theories for flexural, shear, and compression members. Students
develop practical expertise in extreme-condition design methodologies currently implemented in Korea's construction industry.

and Environmental
Engineering Design 1 & 2
The course synthesizes fundamental knowledge from mathematics, basic sciences, and computing with core civil engineering principles. It
emphasizes developing analytical skills for requirements assessment, element design, and process documentation. By integrating theoretical
concepts, students acquire practical methodologies for designing civil and environmental systems.

Planning and EngineeringPlanning and Engineering
Cultivating urban engineers through interdisciplinary
approaches to cities and society
Since the 1960s, rapid urbanization and industrialization and insufficient systematic land and space
management have generated diverse challenges across Korea's urban landscape, affecting housing,
industry, transportation, environment, and culture. Urban challenges, including housing shortages,
traffic congestion, and environmental deterioration, have heightened society's aspirations for livable
cities. Contemporary megatrends, including the Fourth Industrial Revolution, digital transformation,
demographic shifts, and climate change, present additional urban challenges. The “urban engineering”
field addresses these challenges through methodological approaches and solutions designed to enhance
quality of life and optimize living environment development. The discipline integrates engineering
principles from architecture, civil engineering, and environmental studies with humanities and social
sciences, including law, public administration, sociology, economics, and geography.

Department of Public AdministrationDepartment of Public Administration
Cultivating public sector leadership for national
operations and balanced development
Public administration is an applied social science field that promotes balanced national development
through efficient state operations. The 21st century has witnessed an increased emphasis on
governmental roles, highlighting the limitations of traditional governance and authority in executing
administrative functions. This evolution has precipitated fundamental changes in governmental
operations and management, establishing modern public administration as a systematic field of study.
The scope of public administration has expanded beyond the public sector to encompass partnerships
with private enterprises and non-profit organizations, reflecting the growing interconnectedness of
governmental activities.
The Department of Public Administration at Hanyang University cultivates expertise in future bureaucrats
and policy specialists equipped to manage societal changes and resolve complex conflicts through the
practical application of academic research. The increasing public demand for administrative services
underscores the significance of highly competent bureaucrats and specialists
